claims.claim_text: OAS primarily targets defense, homeland security, and public safety customers (US DoD, defense agencies). A significant portion of revenue depends on government customers.
claims.subject: Ondas (OAS segment)
claims.source_quote: OAS primarily targets defense, homeland security, and public safety customers... A significant portion of our business, particularly through our OAS segment, involves sales to government customers, including defense, homeland security, and public safety agencies.

claims.claim_text: Two customers accounted for $27.8M (55%) and $5.4M (11%) of 2025 revenue. Revenue exploded from prior year (OAS product revenue grew from $2.77M to $34.39M, +1,142%).
claims.subject: Ondas
claims.object_value: ~$27.8M revenue from a single 2025 customer; would expect that customer to disclose Ondas if material
claims.source_quote: During the year ended December 31, 2025, two customers accounted for approximately $27.8 million and $5.4 million of our revenue or approximately 55% and 11%, respectively. As of December 31, 2025, one customer accounted for 73% of accounts receivable.

claims.claim_text: Ondas Networks intellectual property has been adopted by the IEEE and forms the core of the IEEE 802.16 standard. Ondas Networks holds patents on its FullMAX SDR platform, marketed to freight rail and critical infrastructure.
claims.subject: Ondas Networks
claims.object_value: non-trivial patent portfolio covering wireless / SDR / 802.16
claims.source_quote: Ondas Networks intellectual property has been adopted by the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers ('IEEE') and forms the core of the IEEE 802.16 standard... FullMAX, our patented software-defined radio ('SDR') platform.

claims.claim_text: Airobotics / OAS markets the Optimus System and Iron Drone Raider; American Robotics received FAA Type Certification for the Optimus 1-EX on September 25, 2023. Airobotics is the source of multiple deployed defense/security drone products.
claims.subject: Airobotics (Ondas subsidiary)
claims.object_value: Airobotics patent portfolio covering drone / unmanned / aerial systems
claims.source_quote: American Robotics received FAA Type Certification for the Optimus 1-EX on September 25, 2023... Through Airobotics, OAS provides the Optimus System, a fully autonomous aerial platform... Iron Drone Raider, a fully autonomous interceptor drone.

claims.claim_text: Ondas Networks has historically targeted North American freight rail operators (AAR / Class I railroads) as an early adoption market for FullMAX, with industry bodies adopting IEEE 802.16 as the standards foundation.
claims.subject: Ondas Networks
claims.object_value: Class I railroads or AAR mention Ondas / FullMAX as a vendor in SEC filings
claims.source_quote: Ondas Networks has historically targeted North American freight rail operators as an early adoption market for FullMAX... Industry organizations, including the Association of American Railroads ('AAR') and related industry bodies, have adopted IEEE 802.16 as a standards foundation for future private wireless networks.

claims.claim_text: OAS subsidiary portfolio: Sentrycs (CoRF CUAS), Roboteam (UGV / tactical ground robotics), 4M Defense (demining / UXO), Apeiro Motion (autonomy stack). These are presented as actively deployed defense capabilities for US/DoD missions.
claims.subject: Sentrycs / Roboteam (named Ondas-acquired defense capabilities)
claims.object_value: any US federal contract activity for these named acquired defense entities
claims.source_quote: OAS leverages unmanned ground vehicle ('UGV') and tactical ground robotics capabilities through Roboteam... OAS also integrates CUAS capabilities through Sentrycs CoRF platform.

claims.claim_text: Ondas had ~$594.4M in cash, restricted cash, and equivalents at 12/31/2025 + $1B Jan-2026 raise. Net losses with accumulated deficit of $368.4M. Material distress flags: stock-for-services / equity issuance to vendors / heavy related-party debt funding from a former director (C&P, Joseph Popolo).
claims.subject: Ondas
claims.object_value: high reliance on a single related party (C&P / Joseph Popolo) for prior-year working-capital convertible debt; resolved via OAS Exchange Dec 2025
claims.source_quote: Joseph Popolo, a former director of the Company, was the sole control person of C&P... C&P paid $2 million for 1,785,714 shares of Common Stock... On December 17, 2025, in connection with the OAS Exchange, C&P converted $1.97 million in principal and $101 thousand of accrued interest outstanding... In January 2026, we raised approximately $1 billion in gross proceeds.

claims.claim_text: Ondas claims operations across ~15 principal facilities in approximately four countries (US: MA, MD, FL, CA; rest primarily in Israel). Implies physical manufacturing/operations presence in the US.
claims.subject: Ondas
claims.object_value: physical US facilities (MA, MD, FL, CA)
claims.source_quote: the Company had facilities in approximately four countries, including approximately 15 principal administrative, sales, research and development, manufacturing and distribution facilities. Four of these facilities are located in the United States in MA, MD, FL and CA and 11 are located outside the United States, primarily in Israel.
